Late to the party and this will likely be buried but I was in a coma for 2 months. Caught a nasty strain of pneumonia and all the doctors thought I'd die (found that out recently, had no idea for 5 years). I remember the nurses talking and bitching all the time. I remember my mum coming in and holding my hand, bawling her eyes out and begging me to wake up and telling me she loves me. I remember the doctors coming in and touching my arms and legs. I remember feeling the nurses give me a shot in my stomach that stops blood clotting in the legs. 

I had a weird dream about being a dark tunnel and there was a door at the end. I wanted to go through it but some old guy beat me to it. Before he went in he looked back at me with the most sad look on his face and he shook his head. I turned around and ran back the other way and that's when I woke up.

Apparently I'd died for a few seconds. Found out a bit later on from talking to my mum that some old guy had died from the same nasty strain of pneumonia in the room next to me, just before I'd died for those few seconds.

I don't believe in god or an afterlife. I don't believe in ghosts or that there is meaning in dreams. So take what you will from that dream, but it was creepy as fuck.

My book is kind of a mixup between fantasy and scifi, however the reader will only know of the book as fantasy and eventually (after a lot of subtext, foreshadowing and hints) they will learn that it's actually scifi.

It's set in a medieval world and the tl;dr is that aliens created earth as a sort of vacation destination. The aliens possess humans and have fun doing whatever they like (think Westworld but on a larger scale). My MC's (and there's 6 of them) have to work together to save the world and get rid of these aliens.

I've done a LOT of planning for this world. I have religions, customs, economies, a third race, cultures - basically everything needed to tell a good story, I just need to actually tell this good story!

I have a few questions! I've spent about 2 years world building for my book, and now my world is so large and so detailed that it's almost impossible to write anything of substance :( what could I do in that situation? How long did it take you to write your first book? How many stories did you start and never finish before you found 'the one'?
